provenance.creator: Josh Goldstein
provenance.usage: Use the reference image alongside this prompt for the closest match. Text-only generation will vary.

image_description.scene_summary: A friendly green cartoon T. rex carrying a developer backpack steps out of an open blue Docker shipping container at a busy seaport. A small glowing turquoise AI triceratops companion floats beside him. The visual metaphor is developers and AI agents shipping software together inside portable containers.

subjects.style: Friendly rounded cartoon anatomy, large expressive brown eyes, short arms, broad smiling snout, small white teeth, thick tapering tail and cream claws.
subjects.color: Leaf-green skin with darker green spots and a creamy golden-yellow jaw, belly and tail underside.
subjects.outfit: Blue baseball cap with a small white Docker whale emblem. Dark navy and gray backpack with three colorful rectangular badges: yellow lightning bolt, cyan code brackets and purple gears.
subjects.position: Left of center, full body, stepping across the threshold of the open container toward the viewer and left.
subjects.action: One hand raised in a friendly explanatory gesture; the other holds a backpack shoulder strap.

subjects.style: Cute small floating holographic dinosaur; oversized head and scalloped frill, three ivory horns, large dark eyes, small dangling feet and a curling tail.
subjects.color: Translucent turquoise and mint with luminous cyan edges and printed circuit traces across the face, frill, body and tail.
subjects.position: Right of center, hovering beside the T. rex in front of the container wall.
subjects.action: Floating at shoulder height amid tiny luminous pixel fragments and vertical data streaks.

background.setting: Container shipping port beside a calm ocean at sunrise or sunset.
background.main_container: Large saturated blue corrugated-steel shipping container in three-quarter perspective. Open left door faces the viewer. Interior holds stacked tan crates and a small green box. The broad right exterior wall displays Docker branding.
elements: Cargo ship bow at left behind the quay.
Low sun near the left ocean horizon with yellow rays and turquoise water reflections.
Small white seagulls and soft cream clouds.
Stacked blue, orange and teal cargo containers carrying simplified AI, Python, JS and gear marks.
Large blue gantry crane spanning the upper-right sky.
background.lighting: Warm golden light from the left horizon contrasted with cool blue container shadows and cyan holographic glow.
background.atmosphere: Optimistic, playful, approachable and busy, with a clear educational metaphor.

text_content.position: Large white lowercase lettering on the right container wall beneath the white Docker whale-and-stacked-containers emblem.
text_content.style: Rounded simple sans-serif, aligned to the perspective of the container.

text_content.content:
DOCKER: SHIPPING AI AGENTS.
YOU & AI SHIPPING TOGETHER.
text_content.position: Smaller white uppercase text below the docker wordmark on the right container wall.
text_content.style: Condensed bold sans-serif, aligned to the corrugated wall perspective.

text_content.content:
YOU AND AI HAVE BEEN SHIPPING TOGETHER —
YOU JUST DON’T REALIZE IT.
text_content.position: Two centered lines across the bottom fifth of the composition, in a dark navy vignette beneath the scene.
text_content.style: Large rounded uppercase letters with dark outlines. First line pale cyan, second line pale yellow transitioning to mint. Subtle cyan glow, short luminous horizontal rules and a few small four-point sparkles.

style_parameters.aesthetic: Polished 2D editorial cartoon with bold dark navy outlines, smooth cel shading, softly modeled dimensional forms and lightly textured surfaces. Match the existing Docker illustration rather than the high-fidelity 3D rendering of the city-scene prompt.
style_parameters.visual_tone: Vibrant blue and teal industrial setting, warm green-and-yellow protagonist, cyan holographic companion and golden horizon.
style_parameters.composition: Landscape, approximately 1.83:1 aspect ratio, matching the 2048 by 1117 reference. Strong central container, T. rex on the left, companion near the middle-right, crane above right, ocean opening at left. Keep the lower title band clear of the characters.
style_parameters.camera_angle: Eye-level wide shot with the main dinosaur visible head to toe and a three-quarter view into the container.
avoid: Two T. rexes, an orange dinosaur, tropical drinks or a city street from the separate city-scene prompt.
Scary dinosaurs, aggressive teeth or threatening expressions.
Generic abstract AI artwork in place of the recognizable port and Docker container.
Clipping the feet, cap, frill or bottom headline.
